name: Tex-Mex Salad Flatbread with Beans, Corn & Avocado Ranch Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ avocados
3 limes
3 tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into a medium bowl and mash with a fork until smooth.
Juice half the limes into the bowl with the avocado; cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside.
Add yogurt, honey, and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes and place in a large bowl.
Peel and small dice onions; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Place corn in a large colander and run under cold water to thaw. Drain and rinse beans in the colander with the corn; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
3 (398 ml) cans black beans

instructions.primary_message: Divide pitas between two baking sheet pans and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven and bake until pitas are toasted, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain pitas
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add corn, beans, and mixed greens to the bowl with the tomatoes; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pitas between plates, then top with salad, cheese, and dressing. Place lime wedges on the side and enjoy!
